create_fastagent_app: create a FastAgent application with a name to initialize an MCP server-based AI agent
define_agent_decorators: define named agents with instructions and MCP server connections using @fast.agent decorators
run_agent_interactive: run the agent application and launch an interactive session with fast.run() context manager
call_agent_tools: call HuggingFace MCP tools like model_search, dataset_search, hf_doc_search on named agents
apply_agent_prompts: apply named prompts with parameters to an agent using apply_prompt method
